dish: Awamori tasting incl. kusu (aged awamori) matured in Chuko's own Nanban-arayaki clay pots
n: Chuko Awamori Distillery — Chuko-gura (忠孝酒造 忠孝蔵)
w: Founded in Tomigusuku in 1949 (as Tomigusuku Distillery); runs free ~1-hour tours of its distillery, kiln-fired pottery workshop and kusu cellars ending with a tasting of about ten awamori. Ten minutes' drive from Naha Airport.
